text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased CrashLoopBackOff for runtime-pool-usw2. 28/70 pods restarted in last 2m. Crash signal: SIGSEGV in /opt/runtime/lib/libattn.so — auto-escalating to #incidents
Maya: I'm on pager. paging @Elena and @Raj for runtime kernel/segfaults. spinning up a Zoom.
Elena: on my way. first thing — grab a recent pod logs + last 200 lines of dmesg/core pattern.
Raj: seen similar after the kv-cache index change in last deploy. could be index corruption hitting fused-kernel path. adding context: previous deploy rolled quant-index v2.
Maya: running -> kubectl -n runtime logs runtime-pool-usw2-5f7b -c runtime --tail=200
Maya: logs show: 
```
[2026-03-17T14:01:02Z] runtime: segfault at 0x7f4b2c0f; pc 0x7f4b2c0f libattn.so(+0x1f0)
Backtrace:
  #0 0x7f4b2c0f in attn::KvIndex::get(...)
  #1 0x7f4b3a2d in Runtime::forward(...)
```
Elena: that matches index path. can you also grab `kubectl exec -n runtime runtime-pool-usw2-5f7b -- cat /proc/self/maps` and upload core if present.
Maya: core present. uploading to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/1745678901/core-runtime-pool-usw2-5f7b.dmp (started).
deploy-bot: Rolling back canary release quant-index v2 -> v1 (initiated).
Raj: short-term mitigation: disable kv-index table to avoid lookup path. env var toggle: DISABLE_KV_INDEX=1. Command: 
`kubectl -n runtime set env daemonset/runtime-pool DISABLE_KV_INDEX=1` then rollout restart. This should avoid segfaults while we analyze core.
Maya: applied env toggle to runtime daemonset and restarted pods. monitoring restarts.
Tom: customer impact: ~12% 5xx on hosted endpoints in US-WEST-2; a few customers reported latency spikes. I'm drafting status page note.
Elena: capturing gdb backtrace on core and packing with symbols. ETA ~15m. collecting heap+kv snapshots.
Raj: also cordon node gpu-12 where many failures anchor: `kubectl cordon gpu-12` then drain non-prod pods. planning to evacuate affected GPUs.
Maya: cordoned gpu-12 and draining. scaling up fallback pool (runtime-fallback-usw2) by +4 replicas to absorb traffic.
Tom: notifying CS and affected accounts, created INC-1745678901 in ticketing with initial impact and mitigation steps.
Elena: uploading debugging artifact tarball to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/1745678901/artifacts.tar.gz. added pointer in ticket.
ops-bot: Incident metrics snapshot saved to /incidents/1745678901/metrics-14-01.json (auto).
Maya: pod restarts dropping after toggle; currently 3/70 still restarting (stabilizing). continuing watch for 30m.
Raj: follow-up: we should revert quant-index v2 from canary across clusters until root cause found. add to postmortem.
Tom: status page updated: "Mitigation in progress, partial service degradation in US-WEST-2, engineering investigating."
Maya: handing off to daytime oncall @Elena for deep-dive. I'll keep watch for escalations. :white_check_mark:
